classification.difficultyReason: Apply the recalled radian definition by dividing each stated arc length by its radius, then compare the result with the claimed angle to decide true or false.

content.prompt: Recall that if we have a unit circle, then one unit measured along the circumference subtends an angle of 1 radian, by definition. Determine whether the following statements are true or false.

children.label: a
children.prompt: 1 unit along the circumference of a circle with radius 2 units subtends an angle of 2 radians.

answer.worked: $\theta=\frac{\text{arc length}}{\text{radius}}=\frac{1}{2}=0.5$ radians. The statement is false.

children.label: b
children.prompt: 2 units along the circumference of a circle with radius 2 units subtends an angle of 2 radians.

answer.worked: $\theta=\frac{\text{arc length}}{\text{radius}}=\frac{2}{2}=1$ radian. The statement is false.

children.label: c
children.prompt: 1 unit along the circumference of a circle with radius 2 units subtends an angle of 0.5 radians.

answer.worked: $\theta=\frac{\text{arc length}}{\text{radius}}=\frac{1}{2}=0.5$ radians. The statement is true.

children.label: d
children.prompt: 2 units along the circumference of a circle with radius 1 unit subtends an angle of 2 radians.

answer.worked: $\theta=\frac{\text{arc length}}{\text{radius}}=\frac{2}{1}=2$ radians. The statement is true.

children.label: e
children.prompt: 0.5 units along the circumference of a circle with radius 1 unit subtends an angle of 2 radians.

children.label: f
children.prompt: 2 units along the circumference of a circle with radius 2 units subtends an angle of 1 radian.

answer.worked: $\theta=\frac{\text{arc length}}{\text{radius}}=\frac{2}{2}=1$ radian. The statement is true.
